title: Phase 6: TECHNOLOGY - Complete Research with Web Sources
description: Weeks 27-30 - Functional technological research. Research compiled from web sources with detailed implementation.

web_definition.what_is: Technology represents new inventions, doctrines, and philosophies developed over time. Each technology belongs to one of three technology trees with approximately 198 total technologies.
web_definition.what_exists: Three tech trees: Production, Military, Society. Each has 5 eras. Countries start with 20-30 technologies already researched representing their 1836 knowledge.
web_definition.how_to_use: Click technology in tree to start researching. Shift-click to queue. Technologies can be researched sequentially. Prerequisite technologies must be unlocked first.
web_definition.how_to_integrate: Technologies unlock buildings, production methods, laws, military units, and modifiers. Each tech defines prerequisites and effects.
web_definition.how_to_expand: Add new technologies in common/technology/technologies with era, category, AI weight, and modifiers.

production.description: Economic capacity - agriculture, resource gathering, production processing
production.effects: Unlocks new buildings, production methods, tools

society.effects: Unlocks new laws, institutions, social reforms

web_definition.what_is: Innovation represents a country's weekly research capacity. Generated by universities and literacy. Capped based on literacy rate.
web_definition.what_exists: Base 50 + up to 150 more at 100% literacy = 200 max. Can queue multiple technologies.
web_definition.how_to_use: Weekly innovation goes to selected technology. Unused innovation goes to tech spread. Research speed affected by tier penalties.
web_definition.how_to_integrate: Innovation capacity = 50 + (literacy × 1.5). University buildings add to generation. Research speed modified by tech spread bonuses.
web_definition.how_to_expand: Build universities for more innovation. Research speed bonuses from institutions and companies.

innovation_details.tier_penalty: Researching higher tier techs before completing lower tier adds penalty

tech_spread.mechanism: One random tech per tree advances weekly
tech_spread.selection: Random from lowest-tier researched by others but not by you
tech_spread.bonus: Unspent innovation (above capacity) goes to spread at 60% rate

web_definition.what_is: Technologies unlock new content - buildings, production methods, laws, units, and modifiers.
web_definition.what_exists: Many techs have no direct effect but unlock other mechanics. Others provide direct modifiers to country/state/buildings.
web_definition.how_to_use: Once researched, unlockable content becomes available. Some require additional requirements (laws, buildings).
web_definition.how_to_integrate: Tech definition includes unlocking_technologies list. Unlocked items reference tech in their requirements.
web_definition.how_to_expand: Define can_research=no to make tech only obtainable by effect.

web_definition.what_is: Passive learning from other countries' technologies. Occurs in all three tech trees simultaneously.
web_definition.what_exists: Each week, random tech in each tree advances. Progress is randomized based on literacy and innovation.
web_definition.how_to_use: Always active. Unspent innovation above capacity goes to spread at 60% rate. Random tech selection from lowest available tier.
web_definition.how_to_integrate: Tech spread benefits from: literacy, freedom of speech laws, trade connections, universities.
web_definition.how_to_expand: Slingshot method: let spreading tech progress without selecting, maximize weeks of benefit.
